title: Normalized scalar tensor presentation
statement: On a small ringed site, for any algebra extension with exact restriction and existing unbounded derived categories, there is a ScalarDerivedPresentation: the ordinary extension functor with its specified object equality, a normalized derived adjunction unit, and the normalized underlying tensor isomorphism on two flat-term K-flat resolving factors.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: Sheafified pure tensors and braiding construct a natural ordinary tensor comparison with exactly the stipulated pure formula.

Choose the existing derived change-of-rings cochain model. On flat-term K-flat complexes its counit computes extension. The K-flat single-tensor theorem compares the published derived tensor with termwise tensor. Compose these comparisons and descend using full faithfulness of localization on resolving objects.

The single-tensor normalization on any two resolving factors gives the required tensor equation. The normalized coefficient adjunction, transported through the fixed object equality of the ordinary model, gives the unit equation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.
